title: Scramble String
problemStatement: Given two strings s1 and s2 of equal length, determine whether s2 is a scrambled version of s1. A scrambled string is produced by recursively partitioning a string into two non-empty substrings and optionally swapping the left and right children at any partition. Return true if s2 is a scrambled string of s1; otherwise return false.
output: true if s2 is a scrambled string of s1, otherwise false.
